join.title: Apply to join our clinic
join.intro: Practise outpatient medicine across our branches. Apply online with your CV; we'll reply by email and SMS at every step.
join.accountIntro: You apply with a ClinicFlow account. Your mobile number and email must both be verified, so we can reach you about interviews.
join.signedOutBody: Create an account or sign in to start. You'll come back here afterwards.
join.addEmailHint: We'll send interview invitations and decisions here.
join.linkSent: We sent a confirmation link to <email>{{email}}</email>. Open it, then come back here.
join.fileHint: PDF or DOCX, up to 5 MB
join.coverLetterMode: How would you like to add it?
join.coverLetterPlaceholder: Tell us about your practice and the clinics you'd like to run.
join.reviewIntro: Check your details. After you submit, you can follow your application on its own page.
join.submitted: Application submitted. We'll email you about the next step.
join.process1: Apply with your CV. We acknowledge it by email.
join.process2: If your profile fits, we invite you to an interview at a branch.
join.process3: After the interview we tell you the decision and, if you join, your start date.
join.processNote: You can follow every step, and withdraw at any time before a decision, from your application page.
join.alreadyBody: Your application is being reviewed. Follow it on your application page.
join.cooldownBody: You can send a new application from {{date}}.

mine.title: Your application: {{specialty}}
mine.appliedBody: Our medical team reviews every application. If your profile fits, you'll get an interview invitation by email and SMS.
mine.acceptedBody: Your staff account becomes active on your start date. Sign in with this same account; you'll set up two-step sign-in first.
mine.name: Name
mine.withdrawHint: Withdrawing ends the review and frees any interview slot.
mine.withdrawConfirmBody: The review stops and you can't undo this. You can apply again after a waiting period.
